statement: The legacy 0.5-nat S_lp label is not invariant to which rendering is called the base: 40-49% (Qwen) and 41-56% (Llama) of the base-0 positives become negative under another base. No family can be positive under all four bases (structural), so 'base-dependent' equals 'range >= 0.5 nat'.

notes: Range >= 0.5 is not a corrected label: it is absolute dispersion with a different null distribution and the 0.5 threshold was set for the signed statistic (v2 B1.3).
